title: Fix #3: Inventory not released when payment fails — stock drifts negative
body:
Refs #3. Fix pushed by synaps-dev (Switch room session, deploy key) to `m26-gen-1-fix-3`; this PR was opened by the company process, not by the session. Merged only after a human approves in #board.

Called self._release() in the except PaymentError handler of place_order() so reserved stock is restored on a declined payment. Added regression tests confirming stock returns to its pre-checkout level after a failed payment.

Evidence (from the RESULT block):
- All 32 tests pass on m26-gen-1-fix-3, including two new tests in tests/test_issue_3.py: test_stock_restored_after_payment_failure (was failing before fix) and test_stock_decremented_after_successful_order (control).

commits.messageBody:
_release() was never called on PaymentError in place_order(), leaving
stock permanently decremented after a declined card. This caused item
counts to drift negative after repeated failed checkouts.

Fix: call self._release() in the except PaymentError handler so reserved
stock is restored before re-raising the exception.

Adds regression tests in tests/test_issue_3.py.
commits.messageHeadline: fix: release inventory when payment fails (closes #3)
